entry.title: REV-246 1.0.0
entry.summary: REV-246 1.0.0: [REV-246](https://github.com/tehguitarist/REV-246) by tehguitarist, a vintage digital reverb in the spirit of a mid-80s studio unit, as an MPC OS insert effect. - Upstream's engine: programmes S / M / L / E / N, the six levers, 16-bit storage with analogue hiss, XFMR, ducker, width. 70 factory presets in MPC's PRESET menu. - MODE: **TRUE ST** (default: one engine per input side, the dry keeps its channels) or **ORIGINAL L+R > ST** (upstream's mono-in path, half the CPU). - OVL lig
